jobDescription:
Job Description & Summary

At PwC, our people in data and analytics engineering focus on leveraging advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. They play a crucial role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth.

Those in data science and machine learning engineering at PwC will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision making. You will work on developing predictive models, conducting statistical analysis, and creating data visualisations to solve complex business problems.

Translating the vision, you set the tone, and inspire others to follow. Your role is crucial in driving business growth, shaping the direction of client engagements, and mentoring the next generation of leaders. You are expected to be a guardian of PwC's reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion and a commercial mindset are all foundational to our success. You create a healthy working environment while maximising client satisfaction. You cultivate the potential in others and actively team across the PwC Network, understanding tradeoffs, and leveraging our collective strength.

Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:

  • Lead in line with our values and brand.
  • Develop new ideas, solutions, and structures; drive thought leadership.
  • Solve problems by exploring multiple angles and using creativity, encouraging others to do the same.
  • Balance long-term, short-term, detail-oriented, and big picture thinking.
  • Make strategic choices and drive change by addressing system-level enablers.
  • Promote technological advances, creating an environment where people and technology thrive together.
  • Identify gaps in the market and convert opportunities to success for the Firm.
  • Adhere to and enforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance) the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.

The Opportunity

When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, youll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.

As part of the Data and Analytics Engineering team you will lead the architecture and delivery of innovative agentic AI solutions for banking and financial services. As a Director you will set the strategic direction, drive business development, and maintain impactful executive-level client relations while mentoring the next generation of leaders. This role offers the chance to shape the future of AI in finance, leveraging your knowledge to create scalable solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced AI solutions for the financial sector
  • Drive strategic initiatives to enhance business development efforts
  • Cultivate substantial relationships with executive-level clients
  • Mentor and develop future leaders within the organization
  • Identify market trends and leverage insights to create scalable solutions
  • Promote innovative thinking and problem-solving across teams
  • Maintain adherence to industry standards and leading practices
  • Foster collaboration across departments to amplify project success

What You Must Have

  • Bachelor's & Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Informatics
  • 16 years of experience
  • Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience building enterprise AI platforms preferred
  • Knowledge of banking domains such as retail banking preferred
  • Experience with LLMOps and evaluation frameworks preferred
  • Familiarity with responsible AI and governance frameworks preferred
  • Excelling in executive communication and storytelling skills preferred
  • Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks preferred
  • Proven experience in banking and financial services preferred
  • Understanding of AI governance and operational controls preferred
  • Ability to engage across technical and business stakeholders preferred

title: GCP Solution Architect Director
tagsAndSkills: GCP,Cost Optimization,Google Cloud Architecture,API Gateway,finops,Enterprise Architecture,GCP Cloud,generative ai
jobDescription:
Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 16+ years of experience in IT architecture or software engineering.
  • 8+ years of hands-on GCP experience in architecture design and implementation.
  • Mastery of GCP architecture design spanning all core Google Cloud Architecture Framework pillars.
  • Proven track record leading enterprise-scale cloud architecture programs.
  • Extensive experience with complex cross-service integrations (REST, gRPC, OpenAPI, API Gateway/Apigee, Pub/Sub, Managed Service for Apache Kafka, Cloud Tasks, Workflows, Eventarc).
  • Expert-level proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Config Connector, Deployment Manager).
  • Strategic experience in FinOps, cost governance, and performance engineering using Cloud Billing reports, the Recommender, and Budgets & Alerts.
  • Experience architecting multi-project Landing Zones with Resource Manager, Organization Policy Service, and the Cloud Foundation Toolkit.
  • Strong understanding of application security, identity management (Cloud IAM, Cloud Identity, Identity Platform), and cloud governance (Security Command Center, Assured Workloads, Policy Intelligence).
  • Hands-on experience designing GenAI/agentic architectures using Vertex AI, Gemini, RAG pipelines, and Vector Search.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to drive architectural decisions at the executive level.
  • Knowledge of Agile Methodology and Practices.
  • Deep experience with microservices architecture, serverless patterns, distributed system design, and event-driven design.

Technical Skills

  • Languages: Python, ReactJS/Angular, TypeScript, Bash.
  • Compute & Serverless: Cloud Run, GKE Standard/Autopilot, Cloud Run functions, App Engine, Compute Engine fundamentals, Eventarc, Workflows.
  • Architecture & Design: Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Microservices, Modular Monolith, Event-Driven Architecture, Hexagonal/Clean Architecture, Twelve-Factor Apps, distributed systems.
  • API Integration & Architecture: REST, gRPC, OpenAPI, API Gateway, Apigee, Pub/Sub, Managed Service for Apache Kafka, Cloud Tasks.
  • Distributed System Patterns: Saga, Transactional Outbox, Idempotency, Retry/Backoff, Circuit Breaker, CQRS, Event Sourcing (where justified), caching, eventual consistency.
  • Data Architecture: Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, Spanner, Firestore, Bigtable, Memorystore/Redis, Cloud Storage; BigQuery awareness.
  • Container Architecture: Docker, Kubernetes, GKE, Helm, autoscaling, Ingress/Gateway API, Cloud Service Mesh.
  • DevSecOps: Terraform, Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Artifact Registry, GitHub Actions, Helm, Argo CD.
  • Reliability & Observability: Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, OpenTelemetry, SLI/SLO, error budgets, HA/DR, RTO/RPO.
  • GenAI Architecture: Vertex AI, Gemini APIs, RAG Engine, Vector Search, embeddings, grounding, Agent Development Kit (ADK), agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails.
  • AI Development Tools: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot.

Must-Have Skills

  • GCP application architecture
  • GKE
  • Cloud Run
  • Microservices
  • Apigee
  • Cloud Spanner
  • Gemini

Nice to Have

  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or specialty certifications.
  • DevOps experience (CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
  • Experience with GCP migration tools (Migrate for Compute Engine, Database Migration Service, Storage Transfer Service, BigQuery Data Transfer Service).
  • Experience building and scaling architecture practices within consulting organizations.
  • Experience with the Google Cloud Well-Architected Partner ecosystem and conducting formal Architecture Framework reviews.

title: Data Technology Consultant (AI Consultant)
jobDescription:
We are seeking a Data Technology Consultant (AI Consultant) to act as a strategic authority and advisor to EPAM clients and internal teams. In this senior role, you will identify, conceptualize and deliver cutting-edge AI solutions for life sciences and pharma clients while shaping enterprise architecture decisions and driving stakeholder engagement at the highest levels.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, conceptualize and promote AI solutions to clients in collaboration with relevant EPAM SMEs
  • Architect complex AI systems such as agentic, RAG, ML pipelines and LLMs as well as classical AI/ML solutions for life sciences and pharma clients
  • Lead enterprise architecture decisions across AI, data and platform layers
  • Drive senior stakeholder engagement with IT leadership, C-suite and scientific leaders
  • Own change management for AI adoption within regulated Life Sciences environments
  • Shape account growth through contributions to RFPs, proposals and commercial opportunities
  • Mentor junior consultants
  • Contribute to thought leadership content

Requirements

  • 18 to 23 years of experience in IT
  • 15+ years in data science, ML or AI engineering with recent hands-on delivery essential
  • Proven ability to code, build and ship production AI solutions
  • Expertise in Agentic AI and multi-agent system design and deployment
  • Proficiency in LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering and RAG architectures
  • Competency in MLOps, AIOps and production-grade ML systems at scale
  • Skills in enterprise architecture across AI, data and platform layers
  • Knowledge of AI security, governance, explainability and regulatory compliance
  • Capability to perform business process mapping for agentic AI design
  • Strong communication skills spanning internal and external stakeholders at varying levels of seniority from boardroom to deep technical audiences
  • Track record of independently owning senior client relationships
  • Strong business case, ROI articulation and strategy formulation experience
  • Proven track record of contributing to white papers, blogs and other thought leadership content
  • Capability to work autonomously while being a team player who can build relationships and drive outcomes independently but in conjunction with the wider team

Nice to have

  • Understanding of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and FDA AI/ML guidance
  • Familiarity with IT functions within the pharmaceutical industry, pharma platforms and clinical workflows
  • Experience with regulated or validated AI systems
  • Experience working within one or more pharma functions such as research, clinical and commercial

title: Data Delivery Director

  • Engage confidently in architecture and design discussions with engineering and platform teams

  • Establish ownership over solution strategy for expansive digital transformation and managed services initiatives
  • Chart multi-year technology direction, including modern platform design and operational models
  • Confirm that solutions deliver on scalability, resilience, cost efficiency, and business alignment
  • Design and supervise extensive managed services programs, spanning application management, cloud operations, and platform engineering
  • Set SLAs, governance structures, performance tracking systems, and frameworks for ongoing improvement
  • Drive operational excellence by embedding automation, AI/GenAI, and DevOps methodologies
  • Remain actively engaged in architecture work, proof-of-concept development, and technology evaluation
  • Head up technical due diligence efforts, solution evaluations, and modernization planning

  • Demonstrated skill in engaging and influencing executive-level stakeholders

  • Strong leadership qualities paired with excellent communication and presentation capabilitie

Nice to have

  • Background working with AIOps, MLOps, and intelligent automation solutions
  • Solid commercial awareness to engage effectively in contract discussions, pricing strategy, and P&L conversations
  • Recognition as a thought leader through public speaking engagements, published whitepapers, or blog contributions focused on architecture and AI/GenAI
